items.html: Now, the eye too is named after SAG, like the aforementioned AHP; and it is in this manner. For when there were the three aforementioned discernments, which are AHP, which are the Taamim, their name SAG there was the discernment of HaVaYaH that is SAG: Yod-Vav-Dalet, Hey-Yod, Vav-Alef-Vav, Hey-Yod. However, in the eye, which is the discernment of the Nekudot, it is the SAG of three times Ehyeh, which is likewise 63 in Gematria. And this is the SAG that is in the eye.
